01 / About

About.

I am a Ph.D. student in Intelligent Transportation at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), advised by Prof. Jiawei Wang. I received my M.S. in Industrial and Systems Engineering from the University of Washington and my B.E. in Software Engineering from Jilin University.

My research interests lie at the intersection of Large Language Models (LLMs), spatiotemporal data, and intelligent decision-making. I am particularly interested in how LLMs understand and reason about human mobility and urban environments, how their internal knowledge and decision-making processes can be interpreted, and how agent-based systems can support spatiotemporal analysis and decision-making.
